decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).

You are required to replace all trees removed by virtue of this consent, on or near the land on which those trees have stood, with suitable species. The sizes shall be of a minimum of 10-12cm 'Selected Standard' size, and supplied and planted in accordance with BS 3936-1: 1992, BS 8545: 2014 and The National Plant Specification. The planting must be undertaken at the site in the first planting season [November to March] or part thereof following the commencement of works on site.Reason: In the interests of visual amenity and in order to maintain tree population at this site after the removal of the preserved trees and in accordance with the requirements of Section 206 (3) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
